caption_L1: Here a area graph is labeled Are you in favor of the death penalty for a person convicted of murder ?. A linear scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 0.4 can be found along the y-axis, marked Not in favor. There is a linear scale of range 1940 to 2000 along the x-axis, marked Response.
caption_L2L3: Overtime, opinions on whether there should be a death penalty fluctuate. A great deal more fluctuation has taken place since the late 200s. More people are not in favour at the beginning of the graph, the 1970s and present day. In contrast, less people are not in favour in the late 1950s, and the 1990s.
